description: Deploy infra: pull-not-build host update script + systemd .path wiring (Task E host side) AND CI workflows + Containerfile build args + Quadlet repoint to ghcr.io (Task F). Grouped because they are the one coherent 'how images are built, published, pulled, and applied' unit and share no code with the app. Depends on FEAT-002 (the host script health-checks /api/v1/meta/version and the Containerfiles bake the version version.py reads), so it runs after it. No automated test harness exists for Bash/systemd/CI here; verification is static (bash -n, YAML parse, greps) plus the FEAT-002 pytest that covers the shared status-file contract.
steps: Rework deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-update.sh to a PULL-not-build registry model as the primary path (default VF_UPDATE_MODE=registry; preserve the legacy git-pull-and-rebuild flow behind VF_UPDATE_MODE=source). Registry flow: 0a preflight fail-fast if jq or curl missing (write_status 'failed' 'jq not installed on host' and exit non-zero); 0b flock on $STATE_DIR/update.lock (fail fast if a run is in flight); 1 write_status running 'Taking pre-update database backup' then run deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-backup.sh (keep the backup on failure); 2 capture CURRENT_VERSION via curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://localhost:8000/api/v1/meta/version | jq -r .version; 3 write_status running 'Pulling new images' then `podman auto-update` (no build, no git pull); 4 write_status running 'Restarting services' then systemctl --user daemon-reload + restart vf-cmdb-db vf-cmdb-backend vf-cmdb-frontend vf-cmdb-pgadmin; 5 health-check the NEW /api/v1/meta/version for up to 180s (60x3s) requiring HTTP 200 AND a parseable .version (NOT merely /health 200, which the OLD image also returns), capture NEW_VERSION, and curl the frontend root for 200; 6 classify per the design outcome table — NEW_VERSION>CURRENT -> succeeded 'Updated <old> -> <new>'; NEW==CURRENT with a digest change (auto-update restarted a unit) -> succeeded 'Refreshed (same version <v>)'; NEW==CURRENT with no unit restarted -> succeeded 'Already up to date (<v>)'; no healthy 200 within the budget -> failed (message points at logs + deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-restore.sh and states image rollback cannot undo a migration). Implement write_status() with jq -n write-then-mv (atomic) emitting EXACTLY the camelCase keys {state,message,requestedVersion,startedAt,finishedAt} (requestedVersion defaults to the string 'latest', never blank); remove the marker on completion; never delete the backup; add a --dry-run flag that writes statuses and skips podman/systemctl. Add a top-of-script comment stating the migration-cannot-be-rolled-back caveat.
Add deploy/systemd/vf-cmdb-update.path (user unit): [Unit] Description; [Path] PathChanged=%h/vf-cmdb/state/update.request and Unit=vf-cmdb-update.service; [Install] WantedBy=default.target.

Rework deploy/systemd/vf-cmdb-update.service to run the script in registry mode: Type=oneshot; Environment=VF_UPDATE_MODE=registry; Environment=STATE_DIR=%h/vf-cmdb/state; ExecStart=%h/vf-cmdb/deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-update.sh; TimeoutStartSec=1800; Nice=10; NO [Install] section (it is pulled by the .path unit and the retained daily .timer). Keep deploy/systemd/vf-cmdb-update.timer as-is (daily scheduled refresh).

Add ARG VF_VERSION=dev / VF_GIT_SHA=unknown / VF_BUILT_AT=unknown then a matching ENV block to backend/Containerfile AFTER `COPY . .` so version.py reads them at runtime (fallbacks keep a plain podman build at dev/unknown).

Add ARG VF_VERSION=dev / VF_GIT_SHA=unknown + ENV to the `build` (node) stage of frontend/Containerfile (before `npm run build`) so Vite bakes __APP_VERSION__ at build time; the nginx serve stage needs nothing.

Add .github/workflows/build.yml: on push to branches [master], permissions {contents:read, packages:write}, a matrix component [backend,frontend] job on ubuntu-latest that checks out, docker/login-action@v3 to ghcr.io with github.actor + secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN, computes a 7-char sha, and docker/build-push-action@v6 with context ./${component}, file ./${component}/Containerfile, push:true, tags ghcr.io/jallamasc/vf-cmdb-${component}:edge and :sha-<shortsha>, build-args VF_VERSION=0.0.0-edge, VF_GIT_SHA=<shortsha>, VF_BUILT_AT=<commit timestamp>. No :latest, no Release.

Add .github/workflows/release.yml: on push tags ['v*'] OR workflow_dispatch{inputs.version}, permissions {contents:write, packages:write}; derive version (strip leading v from the tag, or inputs.version) and shortsha; login to ghcr.io; build+push both components with tags :latest and :v<version> and build-args VF_VERSION=<version>/VF_GIT_SHA=<shortsha>/VF_BUILT_AT; then softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with tag_name: v<version>, target_commitish: github.sha, make_latest:true, generate_release_notes:true (runs on BOTH trigger paths — no event_name guard). Keep tag-push as the primary release path and workflow_dispatch as fallback (finding 5 is documented in FEAT-005 docs; here just do not add logic that moves latest backward).

Repoint deploy/quadlet/vf-cmdb-backend.container: change ONLY the Image= line to ghcr.io/jallamasc/vf-cmdb-backend:latest, ADD AutoUpdate=registry, and ADD Volume=%h/vf-cmdb/state:/var/lib/vf-cmdb:Z. PRESERVE everything else incl. Network=vf-cmdb.network:alias=backend (nginx proxies http://backend:8000 — the alias MUST stay), ports, Restart=always, [Install].
Repoint deploy/quadlet/vf-cmdb-frontend.container: change ONLY the Image= line to ghcr.io/jallamasc/vf-cmdb-frontend:latest and ADD AutoUpdate=registry; preserve Network, ports, Restart, [Install].

Mark deploy/ci-templates/README.md as SUPERSEDED by .github/workflows/ (one-line banner; leave the template files in place). Add a VF_UPDATE_DIR key NAME to .env.example with a commented example value (no secret), only because the host update dir is now configurable.
acceptance_criteria: bash -n deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-update.sh passes; the script's write_status emits the same camelCase keys {state,message,requestedVersion,startedAt,finishedAt} the backend _read_status reads; a --dry-run flag exists.

deploy/systemd/vf-cmdb-update.path exists with PathChanged=%h/vf-cmdb/state/update.request and Unit=vf-cmdb-update.service; deploy/systemd/vf-cmdb-update.service has NO [Install] section and sets VF_UPDATE_MODE=registry + STATE_DIR=%h/vf-cmdb/state.
Both .github/workflows/build.yml and release.yml parse as YAML; build.yml publishes only :edge/:sha-*; release.yml publishes :latest + :v<version> and creates a Release on both trigger paths.
backend/Containerfile and frontend/Containerfile both declare VF_VERSION/VF_GIT_SHA build args wired to ENV (frontend in the build stage).

deploy/quadlet/vf-cmdb-backend.container has Image=ghcr.io/jallamasc/vf-cmdb-backend:latest, AutoUpdate=registry, the state Volume, and still has Network=vf-cmdb.network:alias=backend; the frontend unit has the ghcr image + AutoUpdate=registry.
deploy/ci-templates/README.md says SUPERSEDED; .env.example lists a VF_UPDATE_DIR key name (no secret value).
verification: Do NOT run `podman auto-update` or push images; verification is static only. The shared status-file contract is covered by FEAT-002's pytest.
